primary_endpoint: Blood methionine elimination half-life at Week 7.
efficacy_outcome: Week 7 methionine elimination half-life: 4.29 hours (1000 mg), 4.66 hours (1500 mg), 4.25 hours (2000 mg), and 4.26 hours (no treatment). No statistical comparison reported.
safety_signal: Serious AEs: 0/27 (1000 mg), 0/27 (1500 mg), 0/24 (2000 mg), and 1/28 (no treatment); deaths not reported.
